title: Second LIT trade on the same day after a stop-out, one winner passes, room 60%
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: an MFFU 50K eval must be passed within 10 sessions; maximise P(pass in 10) and minimise $91.80 / P(pass in 10).
verdict: More shots do not help: H1 2-week passes fall 52.9% -> 45.4% (H2 50.7 -> 49.3); the extra trades after a stop-out are weaker. 50K: H1 starts (pick) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 45.4/8.4/46.2% (n 119), within 20 62.4/17.4%, cost per 2-week pass $202.0, worst day $-1,008, max at risk $987; H2 starts (check) pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 49.3/7.2/43.5% (n 69), within 20 66.1/10.2%, cost per 2-week pass $186.0, worst day $-1,007, max at risk $992; 2026 pass/fail/open within 10 sessions 44.7/7.6/47.7% (n 197), within 20 57.8/18.7%, cost per 2-week pass $205.0, worst day $-1,008, max at risk $992; Monte Carlo 4,000 x 20 sessions (5-session blocks): H1 47.3/8.2/44.5, H2 55.0/10.4/34.6; 2021-25 reference (5m) 15.7/7.6. Back to back (new eval after a pass, a fail or 10 sessions): 2026 14 passes in 31 evals ($203 a pass), 2021-25 18 in 121 ($617). 25K ($63, every $ halved): H1 47.1/14.3, H2 50.7/10.1, cost per 2-week pass H1 $134.0 / H2 $124.0.
method: LIT replay (engine/lit.py run_x, the same code as the live loop engine/lit_live.py): 2026 entries on 1-minute bars, 2021-25 on 5-minute bars (reference); live sizing + weekly stop; costs included
